programs.summary: Regional career planning, resume support, training information, workshops and employer connections.
programs.cost_note: Career resources are publicly described; confirm individual service terms.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Residence, training-program funding, services available at the selected career center.
programs.important_to_know: Services vary by site and individual circumstances. Inclusion is not a confirmed enrollment or referral.
programs.first_step: Find a Kentucky Career Center or connect with the regional team.

programs.title: Kentucky Career Center — Job Search
programs.summary: State workforce-system assistance with job openings, skills training, interview preparation and resume help.
programs.cost_note: Career resources are publicly described; confirm individual service terms.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Service type, local office access, training funding, and any benefits rules.
programs.important_to_know: Services vary by site and individual circumstances. Inclusion is not a confirmed enrollment or referral.
programs.first_step: Find a local career center and ask about available services.

programs.cost_note: Career resources are publicly described; confirm individual service terms.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Service-specific eligibility and availability; confirm hours before visiting.
programs.important_to_know: Services vary by site and individual circumstances. Inclusion is not a confirmed enrollment or referral.

programs.summary: Resume building, career coaching, training, digital literacy and support-service navigation.
programs.cost_note: Career resources are publicly described; confirm individual service terms.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Program participation and availability; verify before visiting.
programs.important_to_know: Services vary by site and individual circumstances. Inclusion is not a confirmed enrollment or referral.
programs.first_step: Review support services and center hours.

programs.title: Goodwill Downtown Louisville Opportunity Center
programs.summary: Career coaching, employment readiness and connections to housing, transportation and other community supports.
programs.cost_note: Career resources are publicly described; confirm individual service terms.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Services and program conditions; verify before visiting.
programs.important_to_know: Services vary by site and individual circumstances. Inclusion is not a confirmed enrollment or referral.
programs.first_step: Review this center’s current programs.

programs.title: Kentucky Office of Vocational Rehabilitation
programs.summary: Employment planning, resume development, job readiness and placement support for eligible participants.
programs.cost_note: Confirm any applicable program, training, or incidental costs with the provider.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Disability-related eligibility and individualized vocational evaluation; this catalog does not assess entitlement.
programs.important_to_know: Services vary by site and individual circumstances. Inclusion is not a confirmed enrollment or referral.
programs.first_step: Read official job placement services and contact the agency.

programs.title: KY VALOR — Accelerated Career Pathways
programs.summary: Translate relevant military specialties into Kentucky occupations, licensing pathways and employer connections.
programs.cost_note: Program costs and any occupational licensing fees need confirmation.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Military specialty, occupational pathway, credential rules and individual circumstances.
programs.important_to_know: KY VALOR lists 44 pathways to 55 licensed/certified occupations; a listed pathway is not an individual license or job guarantee.
programs.first_step: Explore the applicable pathway and contact KY VALOR.

programs.title: Kentucky Career Center — Veterans Services
programs.summary: Veteran-priority career assistance, including resume translation, interviewing, labor-market information and job search support.
programs.cost_note: Public employment assistance; any separate training costs depend on service and eligibility.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Veteran or eligible-spouse priority-of-service status; specialized service eligibility varies.
programs.important_to_know: Priority of Service does not mean automatic admission to every training or placement program.
programs.first_step: Contact Kentucky Career Center Veterans Services.

programs.title: USA Cares — Career Transition Program
programs.summary: One-to-one resume, interview and career preparation, with employer referrals for qualified participants.
programs.cost_note: Free online readiness training; additional financial assistance is conditional.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Post-9/11 military background and the application criteria for relevant services.
programs.important_to_know: Possible short-term financial support is case-by-case; employer introductions are not guaranteed.
programs.first_step: Review program eligibility and contact USA Cares.

programs.title: Onward to Opportunity (O2O)
programs.summary: No-cost certification preparation and career coaching for technology, business and project-management pathways.
programs.cost_note: No-cost program; certification exam support depends on program terms and eligibility.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Honorable-discharge and service-duration requirements for veterans; different rules for transitioning personnel and spouses.
programs.important_to_know: Course access does not establish eligibility for every certification exam, credential, or cohort.
programs.first_step: Read the published eligibility criteria before applying.

programs.title: Veteran Career Mentoring
programs.summary: One-to-one professional mentorship focused on career decisions, networking, interviews and transitioning skills.
programs.cost_note: No-cost mentorship for eligible participants.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Service history, post-9/11 eligibility criteria, and spouse eligibility exceptions.
programs.important_to_know: Mentorship is not a job-placement or guaranteed-hiring program.
programs.first_step: Review eligibility and request a mentoring match.

programs.title: Veteran Career Readiness Program
programs.summary: Ten-week employer-connected career readiness, industry exploration, community and coaching.
programs.geography: Virtual cohorts and select in-person cities
programs.cost_note: Provider describes the core Career Readiness Program as free.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Cohort availability, selection, participation expectations and program fit.
programs.important_to_know: Virtual cohorts exist, but specific dates and enrollment are not confirmed by this catalog.
programs.first_step: Review program format and cohort application.

programs.title: Veteran Readiness and Employment (VR&E)
programs.summary: Individualized vocational counseling, training and employment support for service-connected employment barriers.
programs.cost_note: VA determines eligibility and entitlement; benefits vary by case.
programs.eligibility_to_check: VA service-connected disability rating, discharge status and other statutory criteria, with different service-member routes.
programs.important_to_know: Applying and meeting minimum conditions do not automatically establish entitlement; a VA counselor makes that determination.
programs.first_step: Read the official VA eligibility and application guidance.

programs.title: Transition Assistance Program (TAP)
programs.summary: Employment workshops, career exploration and transition resources for departing service members and spouses.
programs.geography: Military installations and selected online curricula
programs.cost_note: Government transition assistance.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Service component, transition timing, local installation and online enrollment criteria.
programs.important_to_know: Certain online courses are available more broadly, but installation TAP participation follows military procedures.
programs.first_step: Contact the installation TAP office or review online resources.

programs.title: Employment Navigator & Partnership Program
programs.summary: One-to-one transition career planning and introductions to approved employment-support partners.
programs.geography: Select installations, including Fort Campbell; virtual center
programs.cost_note: Government employment-navigation assistance.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Participating in TAP, timing of separation or retirement, and applicable program conditions.
programs.important_to_know: A navigator can refer to partner services; this is not automatic eligibility for any partner program.
programs.first_step: Review the locations and schedule an employment navigator appointment.

programs.title: Fort Knox CSP Corporate Fellowship
programs.summary: Eight-week employer-based transition fellowship serving Fort Knox and the Kentuckiana region.
programs.cost_note: Program described as unpaid employer fellowship; confirm service-member pay/benefits and incidental costs.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Transitioning status, Army/command approval, Fort Knox program rules, selection and cohort windows.
programs.important_to_know: 2027 cohort dates are published, but participant openings and eligibility have not been confirmed.
programs.first_step: Ask USA Cares about the application and command requirements.

programs.title: Corporate Fellowship Program
programs.summary: Career experience with host companies and cohort learning before military separation.
programs.geography: National host locations; locations vary by cohort
programs.cost_note: The fellowship is described as free to participate; individual logistics require review.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Active duty or transition leave, within 180 days of transition, command approval and program requirements.
programs.important_to_know: A fellowship placement or later employment is not guaranteed; deadlines and host companies change.
programs.first_step: Check active cohorts, locations and command approval.

programs.title: SkillBridge Cybersecurity
programs.summary: Ten-week no-tuition cybersecurity training and credential preparation before separation.
programs.cost_note: Provider advertises no tuition and covered testing/credentials for accepted participants.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Active service member within 180 days of transition and commanding-officer approval.
programs.important_to_know: Published 2027 cohorts are listed; confirm application windows and delivery format directly.
programs.first_step: Review the NPower program and verify the active intake window.

programs.title: CyberSkills2Work — Cybersecurity & AI
programs.summary: Asynchronous online cybersecurity upskilling, certification preparation and career support for eligible groups.
programs.cost_note: Free to accepted eligible participants under grant-funded cohorts.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Specific pathway qualifications, experience prerequisites and future intake windows.
programs.important_to_know: The posted 2027 cohort application deadline was November 4, 2026—already passed as of this review. Check for new or reopened intakes.
programs.first_step: Monitor the official page for a new application period.

programs.title: U.S.VETS Career Centers
programs.summary: In-person career counseling, resume support, networking and job-search services through participating U.S.VETS locations.
programs.geography: Select U.S.VETS cities; no Louisville center listed
programs.cost_note: Career development support is described as free; confirm site-specific offerings.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Veteran status and access at the nearest participating U.S.VETS center.
programs.important_to_know: No U.S.VETS career center is currently listed in Louisville; this catalog is not affiliated with U.S.VETS.
programs.first_step: Check the official list of Career Center locations.

programs.title: Cyber Warrior Program
programs.summary: Commercial CompTIA-focused IT and cybersecurity training with veteran and SkillBridge marketing routes.
programs.cost_note: Published online daytime cost $23,805; evening cost $24,805 before applicable aid or benefits.
programs.eligibility_to_check: Actual VA benefit coverage, GI Bill approval, local program details, outcomes and remaining out-of-pocket cost.
programs.important_to_know: Paid commercial program: do not infer it is free because veteran benefits or SkillBridge are advertised. Independent funding review required.
programs.first_step: Use the VA GI Bill Comparison Tool and obtain a written full-cost disclosure before applying.
